canvas.description: Standard Vertical Video for Mobile Short-Form (TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels)

topExclusion.reason: Platform status bar, search bar, back navigation, sound selector, live icon

bottomExclusion.reason: Account handle (@username), video caption (up to 3 lines), audio title marquee, seekbar / timeline scrubber, primary CTA sticker

rightRailExclusion.reason: Platform interaction stack: Like, Comment, Bookmark, Share, Audio Disc spin

leftMargin.reason: Padding for edge-to-edge optical balance and bezel clipping on rounded phone screens

actionSafeBounds.description: Guaranteed 100% visible area across all platforms under all UI states

mainVisualFocalZone.description: Primary visual subject, 3D object, character, diagram, or cinematic footage focal point

subtitleZone.description: Subtitles & dynamic karaoke text. Placed strictly above bottom UI exclusion to avoid collision with captions
